entities.name: Gabrielle Kirk McDonald
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Gabrielle Anne Kirk McDonald is an American lawyer and jurist who, until her retirement in October 2013, served as an American arbitrator on the Iran–United States Claims Tribunal seated in The Hague.
